settings.headline: Loan payment calculator
settings.subtitle: Estimate the monthly payment on an auto loan, a personal loan or a mortgage. Nothing you type here is sent anywhere.

settings.headline: Estimate a monthly payment
settings.intro: Change the amount, rate and term. The payment updates as you type.

items.q: Why might my real payment be different?
items.a: Your rate depends on your credit, the term and the collateral. A mortgage payment usually also includes property taxes and insurance.

items.q: Where do the default numbers come from?
items.a: They match the fictional 60-month new auto loan rate on our rates page.
